subject.title: Control UI: settings sections render as a cramped top pill row instead of a real settings layout

question: Should Control UI Settings become a full-page takeover via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102549, or should maintainers prefer a narrower settings-sidebar cleanup?
rationale: Current main still has the reported layout, but the requested replacement changes the app shell and Settings information architecture, and the issue is protected by a maintainer label.

options.title: Review the linked takeover PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102549 as the product decision point and land it if the full-page Settings takeover is the intended direction.

options.title: Prefer a narrower sidebar fix
options.body: Redirect or close the linked broad PR and keep this issue focused on a smaller Settings navigation/sidebar-width improvement, potentially informed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100936.

options.title: Defer Settings IA churn
options.body: Leave current Settings layout unchanged for now and close only after a maintainer explicitly decides this redesign is not planned.

recommendation.title: Review the linked takeover PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102549 as the product decision point and land it if the full-page Settings takeover is the intended direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent merged sidebar/settings-adjacent UI history and the current linked implementation both point to this account as the best available decision owner.
